pieces.Text: You've developed your skills at picking up items while on the move.

You no longer take the -20 penalty for attempting a Sleight of Hand check as a move action. You can attempt a Sleight of Hand check as a standard action in the middle of your move action. [Normal] You can attempt a Sleight of Hand check as a move action only by taking a -20 penalty on the check.

Situational.text: Deft Hands, Sleight of Hand 5 ranks.
